top3.name: Claude
top3.bestAt: Long-form writing, careful reasoning, coding, document work. The most natural writer of the three.
bullets: Web search, memory across conversations, file creation with code execution, Artifacts, Projects (up to 5), Skills, connectors, and Claude Design / Slides / Docs.
Rolling 5-hour usage window — Anthropic publishes no message count (community estimates ~15–40).
Paid unlocks: No Opus or Fable models, no Claude Code, no Claude Cowork, no Research mode, no Claude in Chrome. Pro $17/mo annual or $20/mo monthly; Max $100 (5×) or $200 (20×).
No ads. Anthropic has pledged to keep Claude ad-free.
top3.uniqueFeature: Artifacts + Design/Slides/Docs on free — generate real documents, decks and interactive apps without paying.

top3.name: ChatGPT
top3.bestAt: All-round assistant with the widest tool set and biggest ecosystem.
bullets: Unlimited everyday text chats on GPT-6 Luna (default since Oct 8, 2026) with "Intelligent UI" responses — charts, buttons, small interactive tools.
A Think button gives extra reasoning per message.
Paid unlocks: GPT-6 Sol (Plus) and GPT-6 Astra (Pro), the thinking-time slider, higher tool limits, Codex allowances, expanded memory. Plus $20/mo; Pro $100 or $200/mo.
Catch: "Unlimited" is text only — image generation (GPT Image 2.5), file uploads, voice, data analysis and deep research all have separate, tighter caps. US free users see ads (since Feb 9, 2026).
top3.uniqueFeature: The only top chatbot with uncapped free text chat.

top3.name: Gemini
top3.bestAt: Google ecosystem integration (Gmail, Docs, Drive, YouTube) and multimodal input.
bullets: Reduced Oct 9, 2026 — free accounts now run Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with Auto routing; free users cannot pick Flash or Pro.
Compute-based limits refreshing every 5 hours up to a weekly cap, with no published numeric quota.
Includes Nano Banana image generation, Gemini Live voice, 5 Deep Research reports/month, 5 screen-automation requests/day, 15 GB storage.
Paid unlocks: AI Plus ($4.99) = Flash + 2× limits + 128K context + video generation; AI Pro ($19.99) = Gemini 4 Argon + 4× limits + 1M context + Deep Think; AI Ultra $99.99 or $199.99.
Catch: The 32K context is by far the sharpest free-vs-paid divide of the three.
top3.uniqueFeature: Native Gmail/Drive/Docs/YouTube hooks plus Gemini Notebook syncing.

alternatives.name: DeepSeek
alternatives.bestAt: Frontier-class reasoning and coding at zero cost; the same weights are downloadable.
alternatives.free: Free web and app chat on the DeepSeek V4 generation (V4 Pro: 1.6T total / 49B active, 1M context). Web search and file uploads included. No published message cap.
alternatives.catch: China-hosted under Chinese law. Fine for low-stakes personal use; not for client code, business data or anything confidential.
alternatives.uniqueFeature: MIT-licensed frontier weights — use the hosted chat free, or self-host the same intelligence.

alternatives.name: Grok
alternatives.bestAt: Real-time X (Twitter) and web data; nothing else has native live social search.
alternatives.free: Since Oct 12, 2026 Grok is sold through The X Subscription. The $0 plan gives daily limited access to Grok Chat, Imagine (image generation is back), Voice, Grok Build, capped real-time web/X search, and a starter allowance for Cursor's coding agents. Runs Grok's Fast mode. No published message limit — the old 2-hour caps were retired in June 2026.
alternatives.catch: Free context is ~128K in practice, not the 2M the API specs suggest. Edgy-by-design personality — proofread anything client-facing.
